unlisted_practices: Evaluate the vendor's real-world success at other health systems, product roadmap, and relationship with existing customers before selecting an AI solution.
Approach vendors hesitant to share the measurable impact of their solutions with suspicion.
Track outcome metrics such as the accuracy of predicted impact and assessed risk, and use them to refine the vendor selection process.
Review gaps in the early impact and risk assessment whenever an AI solution underperforms or is associated with an adverse event.
Include nurse leaders, practicing nurses, and other healthcare team members in impact predictions and risk assessments.
Apply a weighted, domain-based risk assessment tool to vendor AI solutions before acquisition.
Consider whether AI outputs will be retained in the EMR when assessing enterprise risk of an AI solution.

screen.reason: This paper presents a conceptual early pipeline governance framework for assessing vendor AI solutions in health systems rather than reporting an empirical study.
